units.source_text: 名人全神贯注，一动不动。

en.t: The Master concentrated completely and did not move at all.

units.source_text: 用三十三分钟思考了今天这一手。

en.t: He spent thirty-three minutes thinking over this move for today.

units.source_text: 本约定白100封盘，名人却提出：

en.t: Although it had originally been agreed that White 100 would be the sealed move, the Master proposed:
